done_when: A note holds the work only at Harm 4 or 5 or Gain 5 (stop), or at Harm 3 or Gain 4 with Work 1 or 2 (fix this round); every other Gain 3 or 4 note becomes a follow-up fix and the work continues, and the README bar table, the guide and the reader and review instructions all say so
why: A Gain 3 review note with little work holds the work for another round, and each fix round brings a fresh review with new Gain 3 notes, so items loop for many rounds (one fix tonight took 16) on test gaps and rare cases
